findings.quote: Three thousand six hundred and some.
findings.claim: Rosa's own figures (406 acres × one pound eleven the acre × 9 years) multiply to about 4,056 (decimal reading) or about 5,663 (shillings reading), not three thousand six hundred; the Bible fixes none of these numbers, so it is an internal contradiction, not a canon one
findings.fix: adjust one of the three stated figures or the stated total so the multiplication lands
findings.reference: bible/world.md, Factions — levies are assessed from filed acreage; no figure in the Bible fixes the rate or the total
findings.arbitration: UPHELD at low: the arithmetic is wrong under either reading of 'one pound eleven'. Recorded; the chapter passes without it being acted on, and it is left for the writer if a later attempt is needed.

iterations.notes: one low finding; orchestrator asked the critic to check the internal arithmetic since no other critic owns it
